spans.s:
mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Locomotive, moveable, that which has motion as opposed to that which is stationary.
E.
गम to go, affix अच्, and the radical reduplicated.

f. (-टी)
A parasol, a catta or umbrella.
E.
जङ्गम moveable, and कुटी a house.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Desert, solitary, waste, jungle, wild, &c.
n. (-लं)
Flesh.
E.
जङ्ग for जङ्गम moveable, and ल what brings or takes, i. e. appertaining to moveable beings, as beasts, birds, &c.

m. (-लः)
A land mark, a limit, a boundary, a ridge of earth running along the edge of a field for collecting water, and forming a passage over it.
E.
जङ्ग locomotion, and ल what makes, आङ् prefixed, with the sense of limitation.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
1 Rural, picturesque, diversified with hill, vale, wood, and water, (country.)
2 Wild, jaṅgala, barbarous, savage.
3 Wild, (not tame, as an animal, &c.)
m. (-लः)
The francoline partridge.
f. (-ली)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
n. (-लं)
1

Game, the flesh of deer, &c.
E.
जङ्गल a wilderness, and अण् aff.

n. (-लं)
Poison, venom.
E.
जङ्गु locomotive, (an animal,) and ल what destroys, from लु to cut, affix ड.

n. (-लं)
Poison, venom.
f. (-ली)
1 Knowledge of poisons, the possession of charms or drugs, and employment of them as antidotes.
2 A potherb, (Luffa acutangula.)
E.
जङ्गुल poison, affix अण्.

f. (-ङ्घा)
The leg.
E.
जन to be born, जङ्घ substituted for the radical, and अच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A courier, a runner, an express.
E.
जङ्घा a leg, and कर a toll, affix ठन; who levies a toll by his legs.

n. (-णं)
Cuisses or greaves.
E.
जङ्घा the leg, and त्राण what preserves.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Quick, rapid, going quickly.
m. (-लः)
1 A courier.
2 A deer, an antelope.
E.
जङ्घा the leg, and अल able, stout.

m. (-लिः)
A snake-catcher.
E.
जङ्गल a wilderness, and इञ् aff.

m. (-लिः)
A snake-catcher, a dealer in antidotes.
E.
जङ्गुल, and इञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A snake-catcher, a snake doctor, one who pretends, chiefly by charms, to cure the bite of snakes or other venomous animals, a dealer in antidotes, &c.
E.
जङ्गुल poison, and ठक् aff.

f. (-नी)
The thigh.
E.
जङ्घा the leg, affixes अण् and ङीष्, नुम् augment.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating or belonging to the leg.
m. (-कः)
1 A courier, a running footman, an express.
2 A camel.
E.
जङ्घा a leg, and ठक् aff.
